summary: Karman Line Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and redeemable warrants commencing August 27, 2026. Units continue to trade as XTERU, while separated shares and warrants trade as XTER and XTERW, respectively. No fractional warrants are issued. This is a routine administrative event for SPAC units, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are involved.
